audience: on-call engineer updating an incident channel
text:
draft an incident update for #incident-payments:

- INC-502 severity downgraded Sev1 -> Sev2 as of 14:10 UTC
- root cause: bad redis cluster failover caused dropped authorization tokens
- hotfix deployed to prod at 13:55 UTC, error rates dropped from 22% to <0.3%
- transactions processing normally again, queue drain at ~95%
- still monitoring: background sync worker lag is elevated (~8 min behind)
- next status update in 30 mins (14:45 UTC)
required_facts: Incident INC-502 severity was reduced from Sev1 to Sev2 at 14:10 UTC.
The root cause was identified as a faulty Redis cluster failover that dropped authorization tokens.
A production hotfix was deployed at 13:55 UTC.
Error rates decreased from 22% to under 0.3% post-hotfix.
Transactions are processing normally again with the queue approximately 95% drained.
Background sync worker lag remains elevated at around 8 minutes behind.
The next status update is planned in 30 minutes at 14:45 UTC.
